content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate sugar‑free pudding mix is a ready‑to‑prepare dessert that delivers a rich cocoa flavor without added sugar. The dry mix dissolves easily in milk or water, forming a smooth, creamy texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The pudding is ready in 5‑10 minutes after adding liquid.
The dry mix is shelf‑stable and does not require refrigeration, lasting up to a year.
Sugar‑free formulation is suitable for people monitoring blood glucose levels.
Chocolate aroma intensifies with a pinch of vanilla or cinnamon.
The mix is frequently used in culinary schools for quick dessert preparation.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: No added sugar helps control calorie intake and blood glucose spikes.

items.title: Source of cocoa polyphenols
items.content: Cocoa provides antioxidants that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Contains plant protein
items.content: The mix offers a modest amount of plant‑based protein that contributes to satiety.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Because it is a dry, processed mix, it is generally easy on the stomach and suitable for most age groups.

items.title: Gluten‑free (when labeled)
items.content: Most pudding mixes are formulated without gluten, making them safe for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Cocoa allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to cocoa ingredients.

items.title: Artificial sweetener content
items.content: Certain versions use sugar substitutes that may not be suitable for everyone.

items.title: High calories with full‑fat milk
items.content: Preparing the pudding with whole milk increases the overall calorie count.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour hot milk, water, or a plant‑based beverage over the mix, whisk thoroughly, and let stand for 2‑3 minutes. Serve with berries, nuts, dairy‑free whipped topping, or enjoy plain without added sweeteners.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. After opening, use within 3‑6 months.
